data: Interdit aux chiens et aux Italiens (No Dogs or Italians Allowed)

Début du XXe siècle, dans le nord de l’Italie, à Ughettera, berceau de la famille Ughetto. La vie dans cette région étant devenue très difficile, les Ughetto rêvent de tout recommencer à l’étranger. Selon la légende, Luigi Ughetto traverse alors les Alpes et entame une nouvelle vie en France, changeant à jamais le destin de sa famille tant aimée. Son petit-fils retrace ici leur histoire. (Early 20th century, Northern Italy. The Ughetto family, living through difficult times, dreams of a better future abroad. The story tells of Luigi Ughetto crossing the Alps to start a new life in France, thus changing the destiny of his beloved family forever. His grandson travels back in time revisiting their history, in an intimate dialogue with his grandmother Cesira.)

Early 20th century, Northern Italy. The Ughetto family, living through difficult times, dreams of a better future abroad. The story tells of Luigi Ughetto crossing the Alps to start a new life in France, thus changing the destiny of his beloved family forever. His grandson travels back in time revisiting their history, in an intimate dialogue with his grandmother Cesira.
